predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. Only a partial set of results from week 1, with the five postponed matches still to report, but I'm managed a decent 13-6 start so far. With teams sitting out so far, the wk02 slate is a bit of an odd mix of situations. == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ The Outlaws. Right off the bat, we get a pairing of teams that dropped thunderous wins on what look like pretty decent opponents. Are we seeing an early-season preview of the potential title battle here? With Vic White not showing up just yet, I think I'm giving the edge to The Outlaws by a touch, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) Dart Knights @ Nein Mark. Another pair that both started off with pretty big week 1 scores. While Nein Mark actually dropped the biggest hammer of the first week, I'm kinda feeling like the Dart Knights have really found something since the mid-fall. DK, 14-10.

Match #3: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Menace 2 Sobriety. A few D teams popped off in the opening week, so this early matchup within that trio might be kind of important. I already thought these were both top four teams, which is immediately bearing out. This is close. Menace, 13-11.

Match #4: (G Div.) Bright side of Flights @ Flight Risks. A pair of teams that rode 501 sweeps last week as they joined the undefeated lead trio. The Risks looked pretty strong, rolling off 14 points in the final three sets last week, and I'll be running with them again tonight, 16-8.

Match #5: (E Div.) Waddle In, Waddle Out @ Rippin Darts. While it's the Bottoms on the top of E, and it's Rippin who jumped all over a good Machine team early last week, I think it's the Ducks who sent the most impressive message. I still think I'll take Rippin here though, 13-11. == A 1-0 Team Against A Team Yet To Play A Match ==

Match #6: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Bottoms Up. The Corks are already a much better team than their preseason roster showed, but I still believe the Bottoms may be the E team to beat. Bottoms Up, 15-9.
Match #7: (F Div.) The Dartifacts @ Shark Shooters. The 'Facts, (up from G) took out Death Throw (down from E) in the opener. Is that a sign of a new, elevated Dartifacts? Sure, why not? 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Wing & A Plaque @ Darty Little Secrets. If my preseason predictions are accurate, this is a huge pairing in the C race. I'll be on the Wing train until there is reason not to be… 14-10. == Two Teams That Have Yet To Play A Match ==
Match #9: (B Div.) Raging Bulls @ Kids Mis-B-having. Tough read with a sort of new-ish team and nobody having played yet. I'll stay with my early read of the Kids, but feel like I'm guessing. 13-11.

Match #10: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Bully for the Element. Darty is back in the division where they should be. But Element is still Element. At least Darty will be warm from Tuesday. Element, 18-6. == Two 0-1 Teams ==
Match #11: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Mulligan's Mafia. There is exactly zero chance these teams thought they would have less than 10 points between them in week 1. Let's go with the Humpers, 15-9.
Match #12: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Bangin The Wire. The Bangers started soooo slowly last season. Is this really an 0-2 start repeat this season? It just can't be… Bangin rebounds here, 14-10.

Match #13: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Flight Club. The Club is a nearly new lineup, so they'll have to earn my trust a little. That said, I'm not quite sure about Salute yet either. I'll still go Salute, 14-10.
Match #14: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ She-nanigans. Oh, She Said was not what I expected. I'll try them just once more, 14-10.
Match #15: (D Div.) One Dart Wonders @ Red-eye Rangers. So many players missing last week… maybe this is Rangers, 13-11?
And the remaining 9 matches, sorted by division:
